dependency: Existing locked winit0.30.13; no dependency or license change
finding: App has no DeviceEvent consumer. Default winit WhenFocused selects raw XInput motion/button/key on root; default trait discards delivered DeviceEvents. All product input uses WindowEvent.
change: Set Never before run_app. Existing X11 implementation stores policy and applies raw mask on first and later focus transitions. Initial pre-focus subscription and already queued events remain possible. Per-window input and separate hotplug selection remain. Wayland setter is no-op.
review: Distinct reviewer confirmed inspected input ownership and first-focus update; no tests or native replay performed by reviewer.
verification_decision: One release build and three fixed quiet native clamp runs evaluate preserved clamp/reversal behavior and absolute CPU ceiling in X11/1x. No mirrored unit test or broad regression suite for the three-line policy call.
limits: No formal comparative CPU improvement claim, complete W-CLAMP work/event accounting, keyboard semantic qualification, otherbackend-scale or independent acceptance.
